claims.statement: every in-scope action was judged by the gateway and recorded before its effect was released
claims.mechanism: signed evidence token per action, hash chain, RFC 6962 tree, write before release
claims.fact_evidenced: existence, order and integrity of the judgement record for each action
trust_analysis: operator (holds the signing key on disk in production)

claims.statement: each repository-changing action carried a certificate of premises that verified against the material beside the record
claims.mechanism: ProveML certificate, store, registry and provenance; replay by PHP gate, proveml-go and the ProveML JavaScript package
claims.fact_evidenced: the certificate's digests and the verifier's boolean, recomputable by a stranger
trust_analysis: the OSV advisory data the hands read (graded inferred/gateway)

claims.statement: the chain head existed by the anchored time and has not been rewritten below the anchored size
claims.mechanism: RFC 3161 timestamp (DigiCert) and Hedera Consensus Service on the signed checkpoint, daily
claims.fact_evidenced: a consensus time and a TSA time for a given root and head
claims.note: Hedera testnet until first external use; the mechanism satisfies 7.3.3 (single-history consensus)

claims.statement: the record names the agent by a fragment of a DID whose key history is signed
claims.mechanism: did:webvh log at abovebeyond.ai with pre-rotation
claims.fact_evidenced: which key was valid for the agent at the record's time
trust_analysis: the operator's update key custody (moving to a hardware token)

claims.statement: the shadow gateway's key was generated inside an Intel TDX trust domain and is bound in the hardware quote
claims.mechanism: TDX quote with REPORTDATA = SHA-512('poc-evidence-key\0' || key); MRTD as the record's measurement; daily refresh
claims.fact_evidenced: that the signer of shadow records runs inside the measured domain
claims.note: dry: the hands perform; becomes the production claim at service mode
